007package com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent;
008
009import com.fasterxml.jackson.annotation.JsonValue;
010
011import java.util.Locale;
012import java.util.Objects;
013
014/**
015 * Immutable value object for a Select AI Agent tool type.
016 * <p>
017 * This type intentionally is not a closed Java {@code enum}. The constants
018 * cover tool types known by this SDK release, while {@link #of(String)} also
019 * accepts tool types introduced by newer database releases. This keeps
020 * database metadata forward-compatible without requiring an SDK release for
021 * every new tool type.
022 *
023 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/CreateToolSample.html">
024 *      CreateToolSample source</a>
025 * @see <a href="{@docRoot}/src-html/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/agent/LoadToolSample.html">
026 *      LoadToolSample source</a>
027 * @since 1.1.0
028 */
029public final class ToolType {
030    /** SQL tool for natural-language-to-SQL workflows. */
031    public static final ToolType SQL = new ToolType("SQL");
032    /** RAG tool for vector-index retrieval workflows. */
033    public static final ToolType RAG = new ToolType("RAG");
034    /** Web-search tool. */
035    public static final ToolType WEBSEARCH = new ToolType("WEBSEARCH");
036    /** Notification tool. */
037    public static final ToolType NOTIFICATION = new ToolType("NOTIFICATION");
038    /** Human-input tool. */
039    public static final ToolType HUMAN = new ToolType("HUMAN");
040
041    /** Canonical known type or the original future database value. */
042    private final String value;
043
044    private ToolType(String value) {
045        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
046            throw new IllegalArgumentException("toolType must not be null or blank");
047        }
048        String trimmed = value.trim();
049        this.value = canonicalKnownValue(trimmed);
050    }
051
052    /**
053     * Creates a tool type from a database or caller-supplied value.
054     *
055     * @param value database tool type; known values are normalized to their
056     *        canonical uppercase representation and unknown values are retained
057     * @return tool type value
058     * @throws IllegalArgumentException when {@code value} is null or blank
059     */
060    public static ToolType of(String value) {
061        return new ToolType(value);
062    }
063
064    /**
065     * Returns the value sent to or read from the database.
066     *
067     * @return raw future value or canonical value for a known tool type
068     */
069    @JsonValue
070    public String getValue() {
071        return value;
072    }
073
074    /**
075     * Indicates whether this value is one of the tool types known by this SDK.
076     *
077     * @return {@code true} for a known SDK tool type
078     */
079    public boolean isKnown() {
080        return switch (value.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
081            case "SQL", "RAG", "WEBSEARCH", "NOTIFICATION", "HUMAN" -> true;
082            default -> false;
083        };
084    }
085
086    private static String canonicalKnownValue(String value) {
087        String uppercase = value.toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT);
088        return switch (uppercase) {
089            case "SQL", "RAG", "WEBSEARCH", "NOTIFICATION", "HUMAN" -> uppercase;
090            default -> value;
091        };
092    }
093
094    /**
095     * Compares this tool type with another tool type value.
096     *
097     * @param other object to compare
098     * @return {@code true} when both types have the same value
099     */
100    @Override
101    public boolean equals(Object other) {
102        if (this == other) {
103            return true;
104        }
105        if (!(other instanceof ToolType that)) {
106            return false;
107        }
108        return value.equals(that.value);
109    }
110
111    /**
112     * Returns a hash code based on the tool type value.
113     *
114     * @return tool type hash code
115     */
116    @Override
117    public int hashCode() {
118        return Objects.hash(value);
119    }
120
121    /**
122     * Returns the database tool type value.
123     *
124     * @return tool type value
125     */
126    @Override
127    public String toString() {
128        return value;
129    }
130}
